title: Document Compare 1.21.22
notes:
Document Compare 1.21.22 reduces unsupported style questions and applies bill-section rules automatically.

The manual Bill / Digest / Opinion / Cover letter selector has been removed. The checker uses the Legislative Counsel’s Digest heading and enacting clause to apply the supported Heading, Digest and Bill rules within one document. Standalone Opinion/Cover letter library helpers are not inferred from bill prose.

Correct load-serving, state-mandated, standalone state and the reported interrupted clause stay quiet. General modifier/meaning/series guesses and generic entity-identity questions have been removed from the production style check. Explicit listed discrepancies and the California Codes, Counties and Entities references remain checked. Source-supported number labels avoid treating structural references, service numbers and administrative identifiers as prose quantities; whole original-source evidence and comparable-quantity controls remain required.

The PDF reader preserves the physical source gap in both reviewed Article XIII B references. Code titles stop at sentence punctuation; one explicit name/shorthand pair produces one supported correction. Three unreferenced helper modules were removed and Code/County matcher construction is reused.

Validation: all 3,008 source tests pass. The actual staged Windows EXE passes AB 1967 comma placement, exact in-kind highlighting, Digest alignment and all nine Digest/amendment results; AB 2266 retains zero style findings, automatic sections and ten implemented amendments after unchanged previously reviewed reading confirmations. Fresh intake covers all 34 original corpus PDFs and 23 bill models / 2,024 pages, with actual bundled parser execution. The numerical follow-up removes 370 of 589 questions on unchanged cached inputs, retains all 142 precise keys and adds no questions. Fresh extraction removes four old Roman-spacing artifacts; final fresh style has 138 precise comparisons and 219 questions. All original hashes remain unchanged; these counts are not human precision/recall.

Complete ordered dictionary authority remains unavailable. Full LCB/GPO coverage and human precision/recall are not certified. AB 109/SB 879 reference differences still need the additional LCB drafting RNs. Tests and model counts describe processing and the specified controls, not every possible document or interpretation.

Extract the Windows ZIP and keep the entire Document Compare folder together. Open Document Compare.exe. Included manuals, offline engines and licenses remain bundled. PDF and language processing run locally. A SHA-256 sidecar accompanies the ZIP.
